en.title: Teardown of ZWO ASIAIR astrophotography controller firmware reveals an unencrypted control protocol

Main control runs over plaintext JSON-RPC on port 4700. The original firmware is not distributed, and the author is openly looking for someone with a device to take over.

en.title: Reverse-engineering Typeless with REA and building a no-login replacement in 25 minutes
en.summary: After Typeless cut its free quota, the author asked Claude to install REA and reverse-engineer the app. Scanning 10,499 files showed that both speech recognition and AI polishing run server-side. 25 minutes later, they had a comparable replacement on their Mac that needs no login and no subscription, with a video demo.
en.metric: Working replacement built in 25 minutes; 10,499 files scanned

zh-CN.target: Typeless（macOS 语音输入 App）
zh-CN.metric: 25 分钟做出可用替代品，扫描 10,499 个文件

en.title: Taking apart Obsidian's graph view engine with REA and rebuilding its physics with identical values
en.summary: The author pointed REA at Obsidian and, in about 8 minutes 51 seconds, located the engine behind the graph view. The physics runs in a hidden Web Worker, with a WebAssembly core loop. Opus 5.5 then rebuilt the physics from scratch using the same values, and a video demo was produced.
en.metric: Graph engine found in 8 min 51 s; physics rebuilt with identical values

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 拆解 Obsidian 图谱视图引擎并以相同数值重建物理
zh-CN.summary: 作者将 REA 对准 Obsidian，约 8 分 51 秒找出图谱视图背后的引擎，发现物理运算在隐藏的 Web Worker 中，核心循环为 WebAssembly。随后由 Opus 5.5 以相同数值从头重建物理，并制作了视频演示。
zh-CN.target: Obsidian 图谱视图（Electron 应用，27 MB）
zh-CN.metric: 8 分 51 秒找出图谱引擎，并用相同数值重建物理

en.title: Studying the Jianying format with REA to rewrite ReaCut, an open-source video editor
en.summary: The goal is an independent desktop editor similar to Jianying/CapCut, built from authorized behavior and research into the local project format. It uses Electron, React, TypeScript and FFmpeg, and offers multi-track editing, subtitles, export and a Codex plugin. The v0.5.0 macOS DMG has been released. The project is still early, and only macOS arm64 has been verified.
en.target: Jianying / CapCut UI behavior and local project format
en.metric: v0.5.0 macOS DMG and Codex plugin package released, with multi-track editing and H.264 export

zh-CN.title: 借助 REA 研究剪映格式，重写开源视频编辑器 ReaCut
zh-CN.summary: 目标是以授权范围内的行为与本地工程格式研究为基础，独立实现类似剪映／CapCut 的桌面剪辑器。使用 Electron、React、TypeScript 与 FFmpeg，提供多轨剪辑、字幕、导出与 Codex 插件，并发布了 v0.5.0 的 macOS DMG。项目仍处于早期，仅验证了 macOS arm64。
zh-CN.target: 剪映 / CapCut 的界面行为与本地工程格式
zh-CN.metric: 发布 v0.5.0 的 macOS DMG 与 Codex 插件包，含多轨剪辑与 H.264 导出

en.title: Reverse-engineering the iOS remote feature to build web remotes for Apple TV and LG TVs
en.summary: Using REA with Ghidra to analyze the built-in iOS remote, the author recovered the Apple TV Companion protocol and verified it on a real device. Based on this, they built a web remote that controls Apple TV, LG webOS TVs and Spotify. They use it daily in their own setup, and the project is still in progress.
en.metric: Tested working on a 3rd-generation Apple TV 4K, with touchpad, app launch and text input support

zh-CN.metric: 在 Apple TV 4K 第三代上实测可用，支持触控板、App 启动与文字输入

en.title: Testing REA against encryption, packing, and conventional VMP protection
en.summary: Starting from a simple program, the author layered on encryption, packing, VMP protection, and software cloning, stress-testing REA over two days. Conventional packing and conventional VMP were both cracked; only the final virtualization stage held. The author credits the capability mainly to the large model and IDA rather than REA itself.
en.target: Test programs with encryption, packing, and VMP protection
en.metric: Conventional VMP packing cracked; only the final virtualization stage remained unbroken

zh-CN.title: 实测 REA 破解加密、加壳与常规 VMP 保护

zh-CN.target: 带有加密、加壳、VMP 保护的测试程序
zh-CN.metric: 常规 VMP 加壳被破,仅虚拟化最后关卡未攻破

en.title: Tracing the Export button flow in a Notes sample app with REA and building a small feature of my own
en.summary: The author ran REA on a six-file Notes sample app and mapped 29 app nodes and 42 relationships, each backed by source-code evidence. They then traced the Export button: the page calls an export method, the bridge sends a notes:export message, and the main handler formats the data and writes notes.csv. The author used this to implement a small feature of their own.
en.metric: 29 app nodes, 42 relationships; recovered the notes:export → notes.csv flow

en.summary: Used REA and Ghidra for static analysis of FalloutNV.exe to find out how the game saves and restores object positions when the player leaves and re-enters a cell, or saves and loads. Produced a spec in which every rule is marked as observation, inference, or design choice and cites an REA evidence ID, then wrote a JavaScript implementation and tests from scratch based on that spec.
en.metric: Reimplemented from the spec, with 31 tests

zh-CN.title: 逆向《辐射：新维加斯》物件位置跨区域保存机制并重新实现

en.title: Analyzing the Chrome dinosaur game with REA and rebuilding a playable version with regression tests
en.summary: Used REA to passively inspect the JavaScript loaded by Chrome's T-Rex Runner over CDP, tracing speed assignment, collision, and animation scheduling. Codex then independently rewrote an HTML5 Canvas version from the findings, adding inline unit and integration tests with fault mutations, plus a playable online demo. Key finding: movement depends on elapsed time, but speed increments only once per qualifying update.
en.metric: Playable online demo, with inline tests and a Node test harness

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 分析 Chrome 恐龙游戏并重建可玩版本与回归测试
zh-CN.summary: 以 REA 通过 CDP 被动检视 Chrome T-Rex Runner 载入的 JavaScript，追踪速度赋值、碰撞与动画调度。Codex 据此独立重写 HTML5 Canvas 版本，加入内嵌单元与集成测试及故障变异，并提供在线可玩演示。关键发现是移动依经过时间，但速度每次合格更新才递增一次。
zh-CN.target: Chrome T-Rex Runner（浏览器游戏）
zh-CN.metric: 可玩的在线演示，附内嵌测试与 Node 测试框架

en.title: Studying WinDirStat with REA and building a disk analyzer in Rust and Tauri
en.summary: Used REA with Ghidra to analyze the installed WinDirStat 2.5.0, confirming behaviors such as directory listing via NtQueryDirectoryFile, a separate MFT reader, and SHA-512 hashing for duplicate detection. Most algorithms were ported from its open-source code, so REA mainly served to verify them against the running program. AI built the Rust engine and Svelte UI; the author admits not reviewing the code, and some features remain untested.
en.metric: 24 automated engine tests; real-world scan of a C: drive with about 1.3 million files

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 研究 WinDirStat 并以 Rust 与 Tauri 做出磁盘分析器

zh-CN.target: WinDirStat 2.5.0（Windows 磁盘分析器）
zh-CN.metric: 24 个引擎自动测试，实测扫描约 130 万个文件的 C: 磁盘

zh-CN.metric: 待办 clone 14/14 逻辑检查通过，/items 响应与原版逐字节一致

en.title: Reverse-Engineering the Electronic Shutter in Sony A6000 Firmware with REA and Ghidra
en.summary: Static reverse engineering of Sony A6000 fw 3.21, with no firmware execution and no camera required. The work has built up 100+ phase analysis reports, 54 reverse-engineering milestones and tests covering architecture, boot, recovery and the capture pipeline, plus a diff against the A7S. It also found and fixed a kill analysis bug in the shared scanner.
en.metric: 54 reverse-engineering milestones; 97 tests in a single phase; A6000/A7S parameter sets match byte for byte

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 与 Ghidra 逆向 Sony A6000 固件的电子快门
zh-CN.summary: 针对 Sony A6000 fw 3.21 做静态逆向，不运行固件，也不需要相机。已累积 100 多个阶段的分析报告、54 个逆向里程碑与测试，涵盖架构、启动、恢复和采集管线，并与 A7S 做了差异比对，还发现并修复了共用扫描器的 kill analysis 错误。
zh-CN.target: Sony A6000 / A7S 相机固件
zh-CN.metric: 54 个逆向里程碑；单阶段 97 个测试；A6000/A7S 参数集逐字一致

en.title: Capturing Browser Actions with REA to Generate 44 RL Environments
en.summary: REA turns a single recorded browser session into an environment manifest, and environment-export then produces AgentEnv bundles that replay the recorded requests. The set covers 37 self-hosted open-source apps and 7 public government/museum APIs. Tasks are scored deterministically against recorded values, and the release ships with a dataset card and baseline results from two models.
en.target: 37 self-hosted apps including Airbyte, Grafana and Gitea, plus 7 public APIs
en.metric: 44 environments with a dataset card and baseline scores (mostly 11–12/12)

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 捕获浏览器操作，生成 44 个 RL 环境
zh-CN.summary: 用 REA 把单次录制的浏览器会话转成环境清单，再通过 environment-export 导出可重放录制请求的 AgentEnv 包。涵盖 37 个自托管开源应用和 7 个公开的政府／博物馆 API，任务按录制值进行确定性评分，并附数据集卡和两个模型的基准结果。
zh-CN.target: Airbyte、Grafana、Gitea 等 37 个自托管应用与 7 个公开 API
zh-CN.metric: 44 个环境，附数据集卡与基准分数（多数 11–12／12）

en.title: Decompiling the Full Server Source of a Conquer Online v6159 Private Server with REA and Ghidra
en.summary: The target is a Conquer Online v6159 private-server package that ships only as compiled binaries. The author used REA to drive Ghidra in batch, exporting C pseudocode for about 48 native executables, and used ILSpy to restore the .NET account server as a buildable C# project. The native parts cannot be compiled directly and are for reading and patching only.
en.target: Conquer Online v6159 private server (MsgServer, NpcServer, AccountServer, etc.)
en.metric: Ghidra pseudocode for about 45 native DLLs plus 3 EXEs, and a C# AccountServer that builds with dotnet build

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 与 Ghidra 反编译 Conquer Online v6159 私服的完整服务器源码
zh-CN.summary: 目标是只有编译后二进制文件的 Conquer Online v6159 私服套件。作者用 REA 驱动 Ghidra 批量导出约 48 个原生可执行文件的 C 伪代码，并用 ILSpy 将 .NET 账号服务器还原为可构建的 C# 项目。原生部分无法直接编译，仅供阅读和修补。
zh-CN.target: Conquer Online v6159 私服（MsgServer、NpcServer、AccountServer 等）
zh-CN.metric: 约 45 个原生 DLL 加 3 个 EXE 的 Ghidra 伪代码，外加可用 dotnet build 构建的 C# AccountServer

en.title: Porting Small Games to HTML5 Web Versions in One Step with REA and a Custom Skill
en.summary: The author says that when they hand an exe or Flash mini-game to REA, about 90% can be reverse-engineered and ported to a web version. They also wrote an ATBGamePort skill and published three live demos: Zuma, Cut the Rope and Kingdom Rush. Cost is about 5% of a $20 plan, and the fidelity comparison is the author's own claim.
en.target: exe/Flash mini-games such as Zuma, Cut the Rope and Kingdom Rush
en.metric: Three playable HTML5 demos, each costing about 5% of a $20 plan

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 与自制 skill 把小游戏一键移植成 HTML5 网页版
zh-CN.summary: 作者自述，把 exe 或 Flash 小游戏交给 REA，约 90% 能逆向并移植成网页版。他另写了 ATBGamePort skill，并公开了祖玛、割绳子、王国保卫战三个在线 demo。成本约为 20 美元方案的 5%，还原度的比较仅是作者自述。
zh-CN.target: 祖玛、割绳子、王国保卫战等 exe／Flash 小游戏
zh-CN.metric: 三个可玩的 HTML5 demo，每款约耗 20 美元方案的 5%

en.title: Reverse-engineering stagewise to build sourcepin, a tool that pinpoints the exact source file and line number
en.summary: The author used REA to read and run stagewise, recording its source map and runtime behavior, then built a tool that knows which file and line a clicked element maps to before any model is called. On the test app, all 29 elements were located correctly, and latency and data volume were benchmarked against stagewise. The project includes CI, a demo video, and analysis docs under docs/rea.
en.target: stagewise (YC's AI tool for modifying web elements)
en.metric: 29/29 elements on the test app mapped to the correct file and line, with zero false matches

zh-CN.title: 逆向 stagewise 后做出能直接定位源码文件行号的 sourcepin
zh-CN.summary: 作者用 REA 阅读并运行 stagewise,记录源码映射与运行时行为,据此做出在调用模型之前就知道点击元素对应文件与行号的工具。在测试应用上 29 个元素全部定位正确,并与 stagewise 做了延迟和数据量的实测对比。项目带有 CI、演示视频和 docs/rea 分析文档。
zh-CN.target: stagewise(YC 的网页元素修改 AI 工具)
zh-CN.metric: 测试应用上 29/29 个元素正确对应到文件与行号,零误判

en.title: Letting an AI agent reverse Rollcage with REA, yielding a data-format parser and a 3D track viewer
en.summary: The author gave the agent a single prompt, "decompile Rollcage into C source with REA", and the agent then produced the analysis docs and JavaScript descriptions of the algorithms on its own. Reference components now exist for archive reading, GT20 decompression, textures and models, and track geometry, along with unit tests and a browser-based track viewer. The author states plainly that this is not yet a finished game reconstruction.
en.metric: The track viewer loads 20 PC tracks and all 66 Stage II environments

zh-CN.title: 让 AI 代理用 REA 逆向 Rollcage,产出数据格式解析器与 3D 赛道查看器

zh-CN.target: Rollcage(PC 赛车游戏)
zh-CN.metric: 赛道查看器可加载 20 条 PC 赛道和全部 66 个 Stage II 环境

en.title: Rebuilding the offline kanban board Taskly from Trello desktop reverse-engineering results
en.summary: Used REA to extract evidence from the Trello desktop app.asar, including the window list, IPC contract, and frameless title bar geometry, and rebuilt the Electron shell from it. The board UI is original, since Trello's interface is loaded from the website at runtime. Includes a demo video and complete analysis docs.
en.metric: Electron shell rebuilt from reverse-engineered evidence, shipped as a working offline kanban app

zh-CN.title: 依据 Trello 桌面版逆向结果重建离线看板 Taskly
zh-CN.summary: 用 REA 从 Trello 桌面版的 app.asar 中提取窗口清单、IPC 契约和无边框标题栏几何等证据,据此重建 Electron 外壳。看板界面为原创(因为 Trello 的界面在运行时从网站加载),附演示视频和完整分析文档。
zh-CN.target: Trello 桌面版(Electron app.asar)
zh-CN.metric: 以逆向证据重建 Electron 外壳,并发布可用的离线看板应用

en.title: Static analysis and decompilation of the Echo Dot 2 public OTA firmware with REA
en.summary: Extracted the Fire OS system image from Amazon's public OTA firmware and analyzed it with REA and Ghidra. All 12 Echo-specific binaries were decompiled, along with the lk and preloader boot chain, and analysis docs were written for subsystems such as the Alexa daemon, AVS transport, and authentication. TrustZone's tz could not be decompiled because it is encrypted.
en.target: Amazon Echo Dot 2nd gen (biscuit) OTA firmware
en.metric: 14 binaries with 11,874 functions decompiled, plus 10,494 functions across 12 Fire OS binaries

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 静态分析 Echo Dot 2 公开 OTA 固件并反编译
zh-CN.summary: 从 Amazon 公开的 OTA 固件中提取 Fire OS 系统镜像,用 REA 配合 Ghidra 分析。12 个 Echo 专属二进制文件全部反编译,另含 lk 与 preloader 启动链,并撰写了 Alexa 守护进程、AVS 传输与认证等子系统的分析文档。TrustZone 的 tz 因加密无法反编译。
zh-CN.target: Amazon Echo Dot 2 代(biscuit)OTA 固件
zh-CN.metric: 14 个二进制文件共 11,874 个函数完成反编译,另含 12 个 Fire OS 二进制文件的 10,494 个函数

en.title: Decoding the realme Buds Protocol with REA to Build a Desktop App for One-Click Noise Control Switching
en.summary: The target is the realme Buds Android app, whose code is spread across 40 DEX files. Using REA, the author extracted the OPOv1 packet format and its two-step handshake, then built a desktop app that switches between ANC, transparency, and normal modes in one click. Both the app and the protocol documentation are open source.
en.metric: Decoded the OPOv1 packet format and two-step handshake; supports one-click switching between ANC / transparency / normal

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 解出 realme Buds 协议，做出一键切换降噪的桌面 App
zh-CN.summary: 目标是 realme Buds 的 Android App，其代码分散在 40 个 DEX 文件中。作者用 REA 提取出 OPOv1 数据包格式与两步骤握手，做出可一键切换 ANC、通透、普通模式的桌面 App，并开源 App 与协议文档。
zh-CN.target: realme Buds（OPOv1 协议）
zh-CN.metric: 解出 OPOv1 数据包与两步骤握手，支持一键切换 ANC／通透／普通

en.title: Rebuilding the Electron Shell of Taskly, an Offline Kanban Board, from REA Analysis of Trello Desktop
en.summary: Using REA, evidence was extracted from the app.asar of Trello Desktop to rebuild its window list, IPC contract, frameless title bar, and geometry layout, resulting in Taskly, an offline kanban board. The board UI itself is original, because Trello's UI is loaded from the website at runtime and is not contained in the binary. The project publishes its repo, a demo video, and a full reverse-engineering write-up.
en.metric: Public repo and demo video, with a reverse-engineering analysis in docs/REVERSE-ENGINEERING.md

zh-CN.title: 依据 REA 分析 Trello 桌面版，重建离线看板 Taskly 的 Electron 外壳
zh-CN.summary: 用 REA 从 Trello 桌面版的 app.asar 中提取证据，重建窗口列表、IPC 契约、无边框标题栏与几何布局，并做成离线看板 Taskly。看板界面为原创，因为 Trello 的 UI 是在运行时从网站加载的，并不在二进制文件内。项目公开了 repo、演示视频与完整的逆向分析文档。
zh-CN.target: Trello 桌面版（Electron app.asar）
zh-CN.metric: 公开 repo 与 Demo 视频，附 docs/REVERSE-ENGINEERING.md 逆向分析文档

en.title: Static Analysis of the gCMOB Android Camera App with REA and Ghidra, with a Written Report
en.summary: The target is gCMOB 3.4.1, a CP PLUS-branded app from the Dahua DMSS family. Using REA and Ghidra for static analysis, the author mapped the startup path, the playback module, and the three-layer verification, and produced a rebuilt, re-signed baseline build; that build was not installed or tested on a device. The repo includes evidence JSON and verification scripts, but no proprietary APK.
en.metric: 9 DEX files and 19 native libraries; clarified the three-layer playback verification and the P2P / relay transport tiers

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 与 Ghidra 静态分析 gCMOB 安卓摄像头 App 并产出报告
zh-CN.summary: 目标是 CP PLUS 品牌的 Dahua DMSS 系列 App gCMOB 3.4.1。用 REA 与 Ghidra 做静态分析，梳理启动路径、播放模块与三层验证，并产出重建重签名的基准版本；但该版本未在设备上安装测试。仓库附有证据 JSON 与验证脚本，不含专有 APK。
zh-CN.target: gCMOB 3.4.1 Android 摄像头 App（Dahua/CP PLUS）
zh-CN.metric: 9 个 DEX、19 个原生库，厘清三层播放验证与 P2P／中继传输层级

en.title: Rebuilding and Releasing a macOS Calendar App in SwiftUI Based on REA Reverse-Engineering Evidence
en.summary: Based on evidence gathered with REA, the core behavior of Apple Calendar was rebuilt, including month, week, day, and year views, event creation, editing and deletion, search, and local storage. Written independently in Swift/SwiftUI, it ships as a downloadable universal app, with screenshots and command-line options. It is a proof of concept and is not signed or notarized.
en.metric: Released a downloadable universal macOS app covering day / week / month / year views and search

zh-CN.title: 依据 REA 逆向证据用 SwiftUI 重建 macOS 日历 App 并发布
zh-CN.summary: 依据 REA 收集的证据重建 Apple Calendar 的核心行为，包括月、周、日、年视图，事件增删改、搜索与本地存储。以 Swift／SwiftUI 独立编写，提供可下载的通用版 app、截图与命令行选项。属概念验证，未签名公证。
zh-CN.target: macOS Calendar.app
zh-CN.metric: 发布可下载的通用 macOS app，涵盖日／周／月／年四种视图与搜索

en.title: Analyzing Cuphead's code with REA to rebuild the first boss, Goopy Le Grande, in HTML5
en.summary: Logic was extracted from Cuphead's Assembly-CSharp.dll using REA and a custom IL disassembler, then rebuilt as a playable HTML5/JavaScript version with three phases and three difficulty levels. The repo includes an asset extraction tool, a Node simulator, bot-driven automated tests, and documentation of where the values came from and what is approximated. The repo contains no game assets.
en.metric: Playable HTML5 rebuild with three phases and three difficulties, plus bot-driven automated combat tests

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 分析 Cuphead 代码，以 HTML5 重建第一个 Boss Goopy Le Grande
zh-CN.summary: 从 Cuphead 的 Assembly-CSharp.dll 借助 REA 与自制 IL 反汇编器提取逻辑，重建为可玩的 HTML5/JavaScript 版本，包含三个阶段与三种难度。repo 附带资源提取工具、Node 模拟器、机器人自动测试，以及记录数值来源和近似之处的文档。repo 不含任何游戏资源。

zh-CN.metric: 可玩的三阶段、三难度 HTML5 重建，附机器人自动战斗测试

en.title: Reverse-engineering Micro Mages with REA into a playable native Rust version
en.summary: The NES game Micro Mages was reverse-engineered with REA and rebuilt as a native Rust project that runs with cargo run. It features a fixed 60Hz simulation, four-player play, gamepad support, and editable assets and settings. The build and runtime include no original binary or emulator.
en.metric: Complete runnable Rust rebuild supporting 1–4 players and original passwords

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 逆向重建 Micro Mages 为原生 Rust 可玩版本
zh-CN.summary: 将 NES 游戏 Micro Mages 以 REA 逆向后重建为原生 Rust 项目，可用 cargo run 运行。具备 60Hz 固定模拟、四人同玩、手柄支持、可编辑素材与设置，构建与运行中不含原始可执行文件或模拟器。

zh-CN.metric: 可运行的完整 Rust 重建，支持 1–4 人与原版密码

en.title: Reverse-engineering Word for Mac with REA to rebuild a native word processor in Swift/AppKit
en.summary: The goal was to study the ribbon, layout, and dual-appearance themes of Microsoft Word for Mac, and build a native word processor, Documents, from scratch in Swift and AppKit. The author says REA yielded findings such as ribbon dispatch and the dark canvas, and implemented 9 ribbon tabs plus workflows like mail merge and table of contents. The excerpt includes no comparison tests or data against the original.
en.metric: Native Swift implementation with 9 ribbon tabs and 70+ popup menu options

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 逆向 Word for Mac，以 Swift/AppKit 重建原生文字处理器
zh-CN.summary: 目标是研究 Microsoft Word for Mac 的功能区、版面与双外观主题，并用 Swift 与 AppKit 从头做出原生文字处理器 Documents。作者自述以 REA 获得功能区分派、深色画布等发现，并实现了 9 个功能区选项卡以及邮件合并、目录等流程。节选中没有对照测试或与原版的对比数据。
zh-CN.target: Microsoft Word for Mac 16.x
zh-CN.metric: 9 个功能区选项卡、70 多个弹出菜单选项的 Swift 原生实现

en.title: Decompiling the Maono Link plugin to write an OpenRGB controller for 15 microphones
en.summary: OpenRGB did not support Maono microphones, so the author used REA with Ghidra to decompile Maono Link's device plugin and recover its control protocol. The result is a single controller covering 15 models.
en.target: Maono Link device plugin and Maono microphones
en.metric: One controller covering 15 Maono microphone models

zh-CN.title: 反编译 Maono Link 插件，为 15 款麦克风编写 OpenRGB 控制器
zh-CN.summary: OpenRGB 原本不支持 Maono 麦克风，作者用 REA 搭配 Ghidra 反编译 Maono Link 的设备插件，还原其控制协议。最终编写出一个控制器，涵盖 15 款型号。

zh-CN.metric: 一个控制器涵盖 15 款 Maono 麦克风型号

en.title: Reverse-engineering Claude Desktop with REA reveals tabular-nums for countdown digits
en.summary: The author used REA to reverse-engineer Claude Desktop and found that the frontend forces the CSS property font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to stop countdown digits from jittering. The property keeps every digit from 0-9 the same width, preventing layout shift. The content is one frontend detail reported by the author, with no supporting evidence.
en.metric: Found font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums used to prevent layout shift

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 逆向 Claude Desktop,发现倒计时数字使用 tabular-nums
zh-CN.summary: 作者用 REA 逆向 Claude Desktop,发现前端为避免倒计时数字跳动,强制使用了 CSS 属性 font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums。该属性让 0-9 的数字宽度恒定,避免布局位移。内容仅为作者自述的单一前端细节,未附证据。
zh-CN.target: Claude Desktop
zh-CN.metric: 发现使用 font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums 避免 Layout Shift

en.summary: Fed up with a laggy, slow Samsung TV, the author ran /reverse-engineer-anything against the Tizen system, aiming to build a clean launcher and home screen. The excerpt contains only the author's own claim of results, with no public repo or test evidence.
en.metric: Rebuilt a clean Tizen launcher and home screen

zh-CN.metric: 重做出干净的 Tizen 启动器与主屏幕

en.title: Reverse-engineering the Windows Calculator with REA to explain why 200+10% and 6×6% behave differently
en.summary: The goal was to explain why the Windows Calculator gives 220 for 200 + 10% but 0.36 for 6 × 6%. REA read the installed calculator program and found that the code checks the operator first and then decides how to handle the percentage. The content is the author's own account only, with no code or reproducible steps attached.
en.metric: Percentage handling branches on the operator, explaining the 220 vs. 0.36 difference

zh-CN.metric: 按运算符分流处理百分比,解释 220 与 0.36 的差异

en.title: Analyzing how DaVinci and CapCut export video with REA
en.summary: The author is building an AI video-editing Mac app whose export stage was extremely slow. Using REA, they analyzed the locally installed DaVinci Resolve and CapCut to see how they handle export, found their own approach was outdated, and switched methods, which fully resolved the problem.
en.target: Video export pipelines of DaVinci Resolve and CapCut
en.metric: Slow export fully resolved

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 分析 DaVinci 与 CapCut 的视频导出方式
zh-CN.summary: 作者开发一款 AI 视频剪辑 Mac App,导出阶段极慢。他用 REA 分析本机的 DaVinci Resolve 与 CapCut,找出它们的导出做法,发现自己的方法已经过时,改用后问题完全解决。
zh-CN.target: DaVinci Resolve 与 CapCut 的视频导出流程
zh-CN.metric: 导出慢的问题完全解决

en.title: Using REA to analyze Claude Code's detection and telemetry rules on Mac and Android
en.summary: The author used REA to analyze Claude Code's Mac CLI, Mac App, and Android App, and catalogued the detection and data-collection behavior on each platform. The findings say the Android build has the strongest detection: it uses Sift anti-fraud and is tied to a hardware device ID. The Mac builds collect telemetry via Sentry and Datadog, with a randomly generated device ID. The full rules are published on GitHub, but the post includes no verifiable evidence.
en.target: Claude Code (Mac CLI, Mac App, Android App)

en.summary: Someone used REA to dissect Tencent's WorkBuddy client and found that the System Prompt is a 378-line skeleton with dynamic slots, into which user profile, business state, and safety rules are injected as variables. Locally, ~/.workbuddy/ also holds SOUL.md, USER.md, and BOOTSTRAP.md. The author is relaying someone else's findings.

en.title: Analyzing six minified browser games with REA and building three playable mashups from the results
en.summary: The targets were six MIT-licensed open-source browser games, first minified into their shipped form and then statically analyzed with REA. REA recovered function counts, property names, timers, and event listeners almost completely, with exact file:line:column positions inside the minified bundles. From this the author wrote three playable mashups, Snake 2048, Tetris Invaders, and Lunar Asteroids, with pure-function rules, tests, and an assisted-player simulation.
en.target: Six open-source browser games (Asteroids, Lunar Lander, Snake, Space Invaders, 2048, Tetris)
en.metric: Checked against the original source: 100% function recovery per game (e.g. 97/97 for 2048); the mashups' assisted player won 155 of 200 seeded test runs

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 分析六款压缩后的浏览器游戏，并据此拼出三款可玩的混搭游戏

zh-CN.target: 六款开源浏览器游戏（Asteroids、Lunar Lander、Snake、Space Invaders、2048、Tetris）
zh-CN.metric: 与源代码对照：各游戏函数 100% 还原（如 2048 为 97/97）；混搭辅助玩家在 200 次种子测试中赢 155 次

en.title: Rewriting REA in Rust with a native Ghidra worker, with major memory and speed gains
en.summary: REA was rebuilt in Rust, keeping the tool contract and Evidence model, and now ships as a single native binary with no Node or JVM required. On an ELF with 50,000 packages it runs about 5.9x faster and uses 8.5x less memory; the native Ghidra worker also handled decompilation of UnityPlayer.dylib (170,000 functions) and the entire Unity.app.
en.target: REA itself (CLI/MCP tools and the Ghidra provider)
en.metric: ELF with 50,000 packages: time down from 1.01 s to 0.17 s, memory down from 500 MiB to 59 MiB; 195 of 209 MCP tools now have native handlers

zh-CN.title: 用 Rust 重写 REA 并附原生 Ghidra worker,内存与速度大幅改善
zh-CN.summary: 用 Rust 重建 REA,保留工具契约与 Evidence 模型,改为无需 Node 和 JVM 的单一原生可执行文件。实测 5 万个软件包的 ELF,速度约快 5.9 倍、内存少 8.5 倍;原生 Ghidra worker 还处理了 17 万个函数的 UnityPlayer.dylib 以及整个 Unity.app 的反编译。
zh-CN.target: REA 本身(CLI/MCP 工具与 Ghidra 提供者)
zh-CN.metric: 5 万个软件包的 ELF:耗时从 1.01 秒降到 0.17 秒,内存从 500 MiB 降到 59 MiB;195/209 个 MCP 工具已有原生处理器

en.title: Passive reverse-engineering of the BTC Pulse single-page app on Base44, with security findings
en.summary: Using passive observation via the Chrome DevTools Protocol, static analysis of an 835 KB minified bundle, and read-only probing of public endpoints only, the author mapped the routes, APIs, authentication, and third-party integrations. Nine findings are listed, such as a JWT kept in localStorage, no CSP, and market data sent to a third-party LLM, along with evidence files and probe scripts. The post-login area was not observed, so the conclusions are static inference only.
en.target: The BTC Pulse single-page app at bitcoinorenai.base44.app
en.metric: 9 security and privacy findings, with 8 evidence JSON files and a CDP probe script

zh-CN.title: 被动逆向分析 Base44 平台上的 BTC Pulse 单页应用并整理安全发现

zh-CN.target: bitcoinorenai.base44.app 上的 BTC Pulse 单页应用
zh-CN.metric: 9 项安全与隐私发现,附 8 份证据 JSON 与 CDP 探测脚本

en.title: Independent Controlled Experiment: Does REA Improve AI Accuracy in Explaining Programs Without Source Code?
en.summary: Using 20 small and medium-sized programs, this experiment compares the correctness of an AI agent's explanations with and without REA, and whether the agent honestly admits uncertainty when it cannot be sure. No accuracy advantage was detected on these programs: 45/45, 44/45, 45/45 on the development set and 5, 6, 6/6 on the holdout set. The agent does not choose REA on its own, and when told to use it, time and step counts increase. The repo includes raw run logs, scoring scripts, 72 tests, and answer-key hashes.

en.metric: Development set 45, 44, 45/45; holdout set 5, 6, 6/6; no accuracy improvement detected

A 16 GiB memory dump was then taken from the PVE virtual machine, usable keys were recovered, and verified files were successfully decrypted. The post includes SHA-256 hashes of the sample and memory image plus a recovery repo, but full-disk decryption is not yet complete.
en.target: C3RB3R ransomware sample libgld.bin and its encrypted files
en.metric: Keys recovered from 16 GiB of memory; verified files successfully decrypted
